t: For an additional amount for “Military construction, Army”, $509,700,000, to remain available until expended.

fable.w: This is a pure appropriation of funds for Army military construction. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision. There is no real tempting contrary reading, since the text only sets an amount and its period of availability.
fable.s: For an additional amount for “Military construction, Army”, $509,700,000, to remain available until expended.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation clause authorizing the expenditure of funds for military construction. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for state/local input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: For an additional amount for “Military construction, Army”, $509,700,000, to remain available until expended.

opus.w: This section only provides money for Army military construction and says how long it stays available. It brings in no one from outside the federal government: there is no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue. Even the inside-government traps don't apply, so there is no tempting reading that would point to participation.
opus.s: For an additional amount for “Military construction, Army”, $509,700,000, to remain available until expended.
opus.b:
1. **Thinking it through:** Nothing here suggests participation. This is a plain appropriation for Army military construction. No outside party is consulted, no hearing or comment period is required, no advisory body is created, no rulemaking is authorized and no one is given a right to sue.
